experiment_name: Resume 027's frozen 32-game PURE PPO checkpoint along 030's exact continuation trajectory (episode seeds 47000-47095), checkpointing every 16 games (48/64/80/96/112/128), then select and confirm whether any early-stop point beats the 32-game champion

algorithm_config.purpose: 030 found continuing PPO training 32->128 games INCONCLUSIVE on win rate, with a large non-pre-registered behavioral collapse (BUY_PROPERTY 98.5%+ -> 0.0%) by game 128. This experiment asks whether an EARLIER stop point (48/64/80/96/112) is stronger than the 32-game champion, before that collapse fully sets in.
algorithm_config.algorithm_frozen: PPOAgent, ActorNetwork/architecture, PPO hyperparameters, reward shaping, action space, state pipeline, and the reference submodule were all identical to 027/028/030 - only the reference's own unmodified train()/PPOAgent.load/save were called.

phase_1_checkpointed_resume.method: Same base_seed_arg (46968) and episode_seed formula as 030, but train() called 6 times in sequence (16 games each: 32->48->64->80->96->112->128) on the SAME in-memory PPOAgent, saving a SEPARATE checkpoint file after each segment. No disk reload between segments. The reference's own per-game full RNG reseed (episode_seed = seed_arg + absolute_game - 1, inside the game loop) makes this bit-exact equivalent to 030's single continuous 96-game call - verified, not assumed, by the reproducibility gate below.
phase_1_checkpointed_resume.reproducibility_gate: 128-game actor SHA-256 checked against 030's own logged value (ad4e9a6d066aab3b2ff5c8414b40669cae51b4bde6d49c42a1ce8128985dd224) before any strength conclusion. RESULT: PASS - matched exactly on the first attempt (hash_gate_128_pass=true). The checkpointed-segment training trajectory is confirmed bit-exact identical to 030's continuous run.
phase_1_checkpointed_resume.checkpoints_saved: candidate_ppo_48.pt, _64.pt, _80.pt, _96.pt, _112.pt, _128.pt - all separate files under the same directory as the 32-game champion, none overwriting it or each other.

phase_2_selection_screen.baseline: three frozen copies of the 32-game champion per game (hash-gated fresh for every candidate evaluation)
phase_2_selection_screen.design: reuses 028/030's play_one_game/summarize wholesale (deterministic legal-masked argmax for both sides, no new evaluation framework) - one candidate focus seat rotated across all 4 seats per seed
phase_2_selection_screen.seed_pool: fresh DEV range 49000-49007 (8 seeds), registered in scripts/evaluation_protocol.py before this run; disjoint from training seeds, all prior experiment seeds, and FINAL_BLIND. SAME 8 seeds x 4 rotations = 32 games used for every one of the 5 candidates.
phase_2_selection_screen.pre_registered_selection_rule: choose the candidate with the highest win rate on the common selection set; tie-break 1) higher seed-block mean net worth, 2) earlier checkpoint. If no candidate exceeds 25% win rate, stop and keep the 32-game champion (KILL). Behavior metrics (BUY/ACCEPT/DECLINE rates) are diagnostic only, never used to select.

phase_3_confirmation.condition: only run if the selected candidate's selection-set win rate exceeded 25%
phase_3_confirmation.design: identical protocol to phase 2, but the ONE selected checkpoint only, 20 fresh DEV seeds x 4 rotations = 80 games
phase_3_confirmation.seed_pool: fresh DEV range 49100-49119 (20 seeds), registered before this run; disjoint from training seeds, selection seeds, all prior experiment seeds, and FINAL_BLIND

pre_registered_decision_rule.primary_statistic: seed-block bootstrap 95% CI for (selected_candidate_win_rate - 0.25), via evaluation_protocol.seed_block_bootstrap_vs_null (same primary statistic as 028/030)
pre_registered_decision_rule.GO: lower bound of the CI is > 0
pre_registered_decision_rule.KILL: upper bound of the CI is <= 0

result: GO - the 80-game checkpoint is a real, statistically supported early-stopping improvement over the 32-game champion. Reproducibility gate passed (128-game actor hash matched 030's logged value exactly, confirming the 6-segment checkpointed resume is bit-exact equivalent to 030's continuous run). On the 8-seed selection screen (same 32 games for all 5 candidates), win rates were non-monotonic: 48g 46.9% (INCONCLUSIVE), 64g 43.75% (GO), 80g 62.5% (GO, highest), 96g 12.5% (KILL), 112g 9.4% (KILL) - the 96/112 collapse is consistent with 030's documented BUY_PROPERTY/policy-drift finding, and the 80-game checkpoint sits just before that collapse takes hold. The 80-game checkpoint was selected (highest win rate, no tie-break needed) and confirmed on 20 fresh DEV seeds x 4 rotations = 80 games: 38/80 = 47.5% win rate, seed-block bootstrap 95% CI for (win_rate - 25%) = [+11.25, +33.75] points, entirely above zero -> GO per the pre-registered rule. Net worth and bankruptcy both moved sharply in the candidate's favor (+4898.3 mean net worth, 11.25% vs 63.75% bankruptcy) though neither is the primary statistic. Champion updates from the 32-game checkpoint to the 80-game checkpoint. Behavior metrics (BUY_PROPERTY collapsed to 8.2% of legal opportunities, well below the 32-game champion's ~99.9-100%) were diagnostic only and were not used in selection, per this task's explicit instruction - the win-rate result stands despite this checkpoint no longer favoring BUY_PROPERTY the way the 32-game champion does.

Production code added for this task: scripts/monopolyzero_pure_ppo_early_stop_search.py (117 non-blank/non-comment/non-docstring lines) + a 2-line DEV seed-range registration in evaluation_protocol.py = 119 total, under the 120-line task limit; no core algorithm file (PPOAgent, ActorNetwork, reward shaping, action space, environment, MCTS, monopolyzero_common.py) or the reference submodule was modified, confirmed via git diff --stat before running. Per this task's instructions, GO is terminal here - no automatic further scaling or re-scan of a finer checkpoint grid follows from this entry without a new task.
